E5_gate_policy.rule: smallest candidate gate whose kept slice keeps >= 50% of MAGE-test segments with accuracy >= 0.85, human FPR <= 0.3, ECE-10 <= 0.05, kept AUC within 0.1 of the document AUC, genuine-label composite AUC >= 0.85, and BOTH OOD corpora kept AUC >= 0.65

E11_decision.decision: final-v1 not defensible at segment level; a dedicated segments-v1 model is required
E11_decision.caveat: If segments-v1 is trained, it is a SEPARATE artifact with its own config/calibrator/manifest/eval and is selected on generalization + calibration, never on in-distribution accuracy alone. final-v1 and baseline-v1 stay untouched.
